hero.title: Axopar 38 Sun Top
hero.heading: Axopar 38 Sun Top
hero.intro: The Axopar 38 Sun Top introduces a new perspective on how time is spent on the water. Designed around togetherness, it is defined by openness, flexibility, and the moments shared onboard. The layout allows the boat to shift seamlessly between driving, socializing, and relaxing, and adapts naturally to how people use it throughout the day.

sections.title: Bringing People Closer
sections.intro: The Axopar 38 Sun Top is conceived around one clear idea: shared experiences on the water. Instead of dividing the boat into isolated zones, the open design creates a seamless social environment where everyone remains part of the same conversation, whether you are at the helm, relaxing in the cockpit, or enjoying the aft deck. This people-first approach turns every adventure into a collective experience. It is not just about reaching a destination, but about enjoying the time together along the way, without barriers, separation, or compromise.

sections.title: Confidence comes as standard
sections.intro: Performance without intimidation. Built on the proven Axopar 38 hull, the Sun Top delivers predictable handling, excellent stability at speed, and reassuring control in a wide range of conditions. The experience is equally rewarding for experienced owners and approachable for newcomers. Performance and efficiency are preserved without sacrificing the open and social design.

sections.title: Your Day Your Way
sections.intro:
No two days on the water are alike, and the Axopar 38 Sun Top is designed to adapt. The highly modular cockpit transforms easily from a forward-facing cruising setup into a relaxed social lounge, dining area, or sunbed configuration.

The optional U-Sofa, with adjustable backrests, flexible seating, and a versatile hi-lo table, allows the space to evolve naturally throughout the day. Morning cruising, afternoon swimming, or evening dining all take place in one intelligent and flexible environment that suits your lifestyle.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

sections.title: Aft Deck Layouts & Configurations
sections.intro: We want to provide you with an extensively customizable, user-friendly boat that meets your everyday needs year-round and supports all your adventures. The configuration you choose will define the final layout of your boat. Below are a few examples of exterior layouts available.

items.title: Open Aft (Standard)
items.text: With standard 3+4 Sports Seats with Fixed Table & standard Fore Deck layout.

items.title: Aft Deck Bench
items.text: With optional Port & Starboard Bench Seats, and Activity Platforms. Standard 3+4 Sports Seats, Bulwark Seats. U-Sofa with Sunbed Cushion infill in bow.

items.title: Wet Bar
items.text: With optional Port Fenderbox Bench Seat, Activity Platforms. Driver’s Sofa, Aft Sofa, and Bulwark Seats in Cockpit (Available in September 2026), U-Sofa with Table in the bow.

items.title: Cockpit U-Sofa
items.text: With Standard 3 Sports Seats. Double Fenderbox bench Seats. Gullwing Door Cushions & U-Sofa with table in the bow.

items.title: Cockpit U-Sofa with Sunbed Infill
items.text: With Sunbed Infill with Driver’s Sofa. Stbd. Fenderbox Bench Seat, Fenderbox Wet Bar, and Activity Platforms. Gullwing Door Cushions & U-Sofa with table in the bow.

items.title: Dinette & Sun Lounge
items.text: With Table. Optional Port & Starboard Bench Seats, and Activity Platforms. Standard 3+4 Sports Seats, Bulwark Seats. U-Sofa with Sunbed Cushion infill in the bow.

items.title: Dinette & Sun Lounge
items.text: With Sunbed Cushion Infill. Optional Port & Starboard Bench Seats, and Activity Platforms. Standard 3+4 Sports Seats, Bulwark Seats. U-Sofa with Sunbed Cushion infill in the bow.

items.title: Aft Cabin
items.text: With Stbd. Fenderbox Bench Seat, and Activity Platforms. Driver’s Sofa and Aft Sofa in the cockpit, with Bulwark Seats. Gullwing Door Cushions and Sun lounge in the bow.

items.caption: Versatile aft layouts, foldable activity platforms, and smart storage solutions create more space, seating, and easier access to the water. The result is a larger, more flexible social area that connects seamlessly with the cockpit, making movement and activities feel natural and intuitive.

The bow is a true social space, offering a relaxed area for sitting, dining, lounging, or sunbathing. With flexible layout options and an inviting, open design, it becomes a natural place to gather, whether underway or at anchor.

Below deck, the front cabin is designed to feel bright, open, and practical for everyday use. Increased headroom, a new kitchen module, and the option for a separate toilet and shower make the space more comfortable and functional for longer stays onboard, supporting more complete and livable boating.
Enjoy sun and fresh air with the Sun Top roof, and stay comfortable and protected when conditions change.

items.name: The Sun Top Advantage
items.title: The Sun Top Advantage
items.text:
At the center of the concept is the distinctive Sun Top roof, designed to protect without closing off the experience. The sliding canvas roof opens the entire helm and cockpit to the sky, bringing in light, air, and a true sense of freedom.

When conditions change, shade and shelter are already in place. Optional roll-down canopies provide additional protection, maintaining comfort onboard without reducing visibility or the feeling of openness.

The result is a more versatile open boat, ready to be enjoyed in a wider range of conditions throughout the day.

items.name: Proven Performance Platform
items.title: Proven Performance Platform
items.text: The Axopar 38 Sun Top introduces a new, more social way to experience open boating, while remaining firmly built on the proven Axopar 38 platform. The hull delivers confident handling, high efficiency, and predictable control in a wide range of conditions. This means the open, social layout comes without compromise. Everyone stays connected in a single shared space while the drive remains precise, stable, and easy to manage. It is performance you trust, combined with a boating experience designed to be enjoyed together.

items.name: Effortless Ownership
items.title: Effortless Ownership
items.text: This platform is designed for efficiency and usability. Optimized fuel consumption, practical durability, and easy maintenance make the Axopar 38 Sun Top as straightforward to own as it is to drive. Every solution has a purpose. Unnecessary complexity is avoided in favor of what truly improves the experience, resulting in a boat that feels simple, intuitive, and ready to be used again and again.

items.name: Modular Throughout
items.title: Modular Throughout
items.text:
The Axopar 38 Sun Top is designed as a modular platform from bow to stern. Every area of the boat is developed with flexibility in mind, allowing it to adapt to different activities, preferences, and ways of spending time on the water. From the social bow layout to the configurable cockpit and versatile aft deck, each space works independently while remaining part of a cohesive whole. The boat can shift naturally from active use to relaxed moments without disruption.

The result is a more personal boating experience, where the layout supports how the boat is used rather than defining it. A platform that evolves with the day, and with the people on board.

items.name: Distinctive Design
items.title: Distinctive Design
items.text: The Axopar 38 Sun Top carries a strong and distinctive design identity, shaped by purpose rather than decoration. Every line reflects its capability, giving the boat a confident and composed presence on the water. This clear, functional design language reinforces its position within the adventure boat category. It looks ready to perform, because it is. A design that communicates strength, versatility, and intent from every angle.

items.name: Activity Platforms
items.title: Activity Platforms
items.text: The foldable Activity Platforms expand the aft deck into a larger, more versatile space that adapts to whatever the day brings. When opened, they create a wider area for watersports, swimming, and social moments, giving everyone more room to move comfortably around the stern. Being manually operated, they offer a straightforward, reliable solution that works every time without added complexity. Designed to enhance both functionality and ease of movement, the platforms bring real usability to the aft deck and elevate the overall experience onboard.

items.name: Bench Seats
items.title: Bench Seats
items.text: A fenderbox can be more than just storage. Choose the optional Fenderbox Bench Seats with storage to transform it into a comfortable place to unwind. It adds extra seating and creates a natural spot for socializing, making the most of every moment on the water.

items.name: Fenderbox Wetbar
items.title: Fenderbox Wetbar
items.text: The very popular Wet Bar in Fenderbox offers a convenient outdoor galley with features like a sink with faucet and refrigerator, all integrated into the fender storage compartment, ideal for entertaining and enhancing usability.

items.name: Enclosed Toilet
items.title: Enclosed Toilet
items.text: The enclosed toilet in the front cabin adds everyday practicality and comfort for longer days on the water. The compartment offers generous standing height and a clean, modern design that integrates naturally into the cabin layout. Optional warm water and shower capability further expands onboard usability, making the space suitable for quick freshen‑ups.

items.name: Pentry Module
items.title: Pentry Module
items.text: The Pentry Module adds practical convenience to the front cabin with dedicated space for a fridge and coffee machine. With an optional drawer fridge and cooktop, it supports quick meals and refreshments without taking up valuable cabin space. Its clean, efficient layout keeps everyday essentials easily accessible, enhancing comfort on longer days afloat.

items.name: U-Sofa in Bow
items.title: U-Sofa in Bow
items.text: The U‑sofa package transforms the bow into a true social zone. The wraparound seating creates an inviting space for conversations, meals, and relaxed cruising, while the central table supports dining and entertainment. The layout can also convert into a full sunbed, giving the bow multiple functions for different situations. With its open feel and multiple configuration options, the bow becomes one of the most versatile and enjoyable spaces onboard.

items.name: Gullwing Doors
items.title: Gullwing Doors
items.text: The iconic Gullwing Doors open the forward cabin to the outside, letting in fresh air and natural light. They make stepping in and out effortless and turn the cabin into an inviting space to relax when anchored or docked.

items.name: Bulwark Seats
items.title: Bulwark Seats
items.text: Additional optional seating along the port and/or starboard bulwarks, together with the adaptable helm seating, supports both ease of movement and interaction, making it simple for people to gather around the driving area

items.title: The Mediterrana Edition
modal_text:
Designed for those who enjoy lounging, socializing, or cruising in the sun, the Mediterrana Edition enhances onboard comfort and sophistication without compromising functionality. Luxurious features include thicker, plush, more refined cushions in a sophisticated beige tone. The upholstery’s structured texture and patterns not only exude style but also keep lounging areas cool and comfortable, even on the sunniest days.

Elegant bamboo trays and cup holders, along with warm-toned interior finishes, create an inviting, cozy atmosphere. Beige fabric wall panels and bamboo technical panels further enhance the sophisticated look and feel of the lounging areas.

items.title: BRABUS Line Color Edition
modal_text: For style-conscious customers looking to make their Axopar 38 truly stand out, the Brabus Line Color Edition introduces four striking hull colors: the vibrant, playful Miami Blue; the more subtle, sophisticated Platinum Grey. The fresh, contemporary Glacier Blue; and the timeless, elegant Pearl White.

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: Experience the ultimate expression of power, style, and exclusivity with the BRABUS Performance Line. Designed for boaters who seek more from every journey, this upgrade combines the impressive performance of twin Mercury V10 425 hp engines with signature BRABUS styling details for an unmistakable presence on the water. The result is faster acceleration, greater responsiveness, and a more engaging driving experience, complemented by exclusive design elements that set your boat apart.
